messages:
morgan: Doing a quick sweep across api-gateway / auth / console / billing / runtime for audit logging coverage gaps — found a set of customer-facing evidence fallthroughs. Need triage and owners.

sam: Can you enumerate the highest-risk gaps?

morgan: Short list: api-gateway: blocked & ratelimit events missing client_app_id and client_cert_subject; auth: service-account key_rotation and token_refresh missing rotation_reason and initiator; console: admin_impersonation and account_settings.change sometimes not emitted; billing: invoice_download not logged (we only log view); runtime: model.deploy shows but model.rollback and fallback.reason absent.

alina: KMS note: many services only log key_id. Auditors want key_arn + previous_key_id + rotation_reason for provenance. Proposal: default stream -> kid_hash, secure archive -> full ARN + rotation metadata.

sam: RBAC changes need before_roles, after_roles, approver_id, and authz_policy_version. Keep schema backward-compatible and add schema_version.

kai: I'll produce a matrix CSV (service,event,coverage,missing_fields,owner,priority,notes) and attach grep output. ETA ~24h.

jordan: I'll pick up api-gateway and console tickets. Will include sample events and acceptance tests for QA.

morgan: Assignments: api-gw -> @jordan, auth -> @alina, billing -> @sam, runtime -> @kai. I'll own rollout coordination and customer comms + enterprise feature-flag plan.

auditeer-bot: sample event emitted for validation: {"event_type":"audit.sample","svc":"api-gateway","id":"e-20240701-01","status":"emitted"}

morgan: Policy note: default schema should avoid PII. Offer enterprise opt-in richer audit stream (client_geo, key_arn) behind consent and stricter retention. Checkpoint in 72h.
